our_interpretation: This expresses uncertainty about LLM business economics, rather than asserting a specified company's loss or predicting that profitability will never be achieved.
The surrounding discussion identifies possible costs but supplies no company population, accounting measure or test for when profitability would cease to be 'in question'.
Treating this as a firm claim of industry-wide net losses would add a commitment Marcus did not make.
criteria.support_condition: No determinate condition can be assigned without replacing the stated uncertainty with a stronger financial proposition.
criteria.contradiction_condition: No determinate condition can be assigned: one company's profit, or one profitable period, would not necessarily eliminate the broader uncertainty expressed.
